biocs.name: Suspicious Module Load using Direct Syscall
biocs.description: Detection of a process loading a module using direct syscall techniques, bypassing EDR hooks.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malicious.dll'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
